definitions.explanation: Very formal adverb expressing sincere or heartfelt emphasis. Common in business apologies, thank-yous, and ceremonial speech.

examples.japanese: {誠|まこと}に⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
{誠|まこと}に⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません→申し訳ございません：18087_moushiwakegozaimasen⟧。
{誠|まこと}に⟦{勝手|かって}→勝手：03021_katte⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、{明日|あす}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{休業|きゅうぎょう}→休業：11541_kyuugyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: Most regrettably, we will be closed tomorrow.

notes:
Very formal adverb that heightens the sincerity of the following expression. Heard constantly in customer-service announcements, business emails, and ceremonial speech, but rare in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誠|まこと}に⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧: thank you very much
- {誠|まこと}に⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません→申し訳ございません：18087_moushiwakegozaimasen⟧ / ⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧: I am truly sorry
- {誠|まこと}に⟦{恐縮|きょうしゅく}→恐縮：07596_kyoushuku⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧: I am extremely sorry to ask, but...
- {誠|まこと}に⟦{残念|ざんねん}→残念：01244_zannen⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧: most regrettably
- {誠|まこと}に⟦{勝手|かって}→勝手：03021_katte⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧: most presumptuously (set phrase for business notices)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: really — neutral; all registers
- ⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: truly; indeed — formal/literary, more emphatic of feeling
- ⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧: very; greatly — formal but less humble than {誠|まこと}に
